scope: Authored task recipes linked to generated method metadata; not an exhaustive list of all possible procedures.

attach.purpose: Attach to the exact operator-selected ETABS process and prove identity before reading.
attach.status: Implemented getter host; each live target still needs its own identity and operation scope.
prerequisites: Selected PID plus start time, executable/runtime fingerprint and expected model; use the maintained lease and supervised STA broker.
steps: Discover processes without API calls and select the exact target.
Use GetObjectProcess, then read version, filename, present/database units and lock state through the existing host.
Bind the current target and preflight state; run only the selected registered getter profile.
Compare postflight state and release the worker-owned COM references and lease.
checks: GetPresentUnits returns an enum directly; do not decode it as status.
A filename or lock flag does not prove an unsaved in-memory model is clean.
Never attach to an arbitrary active instance as a fallback.

verification.qualification: Retained host/broker evidence only for the exact runtime, selected target and registered getter profile; no arbitrary attachment or mutation qualification.

overview.purpose: Read lightweight model counts, stories, sections, cases and combinations before choosing acquisition scope.
overview.status: Implemented; retained installed scope recorded in etabs-bounded-acquisition receipt.
prerequisites: Valid exact target and inspection getter profile; bounded overview request.
steps: Dispatch the existing OverviewWorker request.
Read metadata/counts and name lists through EtabsInspectionReader overviewOnly.
Project and retain the overview artifact with source/journal hashes; request geometry or forces only when the next action needs them.
checks: Overview proves neither geometry nor forces nor beam-design support.
Respect count-zero/null-array results rather than inventing a row.

verification.qualification: Installed lightweight overview on the retained large model and fixture; neither detailed-force support nor project-end PF9 certification.

geometry.purpose: Acquire frame identities and geometry for selected members without fetching all force results.
geometry.status: Implemented context capture; detailed support/topology interpretation remains profile-specific.
prerequisites: Valid target; explicit geometry need; context identity bound to later force requests.
steps: Reuse EtabsContextCapture to read GetAllFrames once.
Preserve frame unique names, labels, stories, endpoints, sections and source coordinates.
Project/cache by exact context identity; use member/point getters only for details the next operation requires.
checks: Object and element identities are different; meshed points may not appear among physical endpoints.
Local axes, insertion offsets and physical faces must remain explicit.
Do not use geometry-only data as a complete support or design model.

On the frozen M02 sample, direct GetElm returns CSI 1. Reuse the version-1 Objects and Elements - Frames table with explicit ObjType=Frame filtering, then reverse-check element owners/endpoints; raw RDI/RDJ semantics remain unqualified.

verification.qualification: Retained context/member profiles plus the 20-frame C0a source packet: 68 reconciled elements. Physical supports/spans and actual force stations remain unqualified.

materials.purpose: Resolve assigned sections, concrete and reinforcement properties with explicit provenance.
materials.status: Existing getters and decoders cover declared profiles; presence of other section methods does not extend design support.
prerequisites: Current member/context identity; declared section and engineering applicability profile.
steps: Read assigned section and any auto-select list.
Resolve its type before the corresponding shape getter.

For the source profile, resolve effective material from the complete version-1 Frame Assignments - Material Overwrites table and actual section/material getters. Never interpret an error output as no overwrite.
Read concrete and separate longitudinal/transverse rebar materials.
Retain original properties and unit basis; keep proposed defaults separate from source facts.
checks: A rectangular decoder cannot silently handle every available section type.
GetRebarBeam describes section reinforcement settings; do not treat them as a completed design.
GetMaterialOverwrite returns CSI 1 on every frozen M02 sample frame; its empty error output is not an absence sentinel. CSI Fc is not automatically IS fck.

verification.qualification: Twenty live rectangular source members resolve through the complete empty overwrite table; explicit overwrite rows are fixture-qualified only. Other shapes and code-strength mapping remain separate.

forces.purpose: Read member or batch frame-force rows efficiently from already available analysis results.
forces.status: Implemented member/batch/group paths; installed evidence applies only to retained scopes.
prerequisites: Current target/context, already-finished source results, explicit member/case/combination scope and observable output settings.
steps: Use the existing force request, selecting the smallest member/batch scope needed.
Read status, selected output cases/combinations and result options through the force getter profile.
Call FrameForce through the retained member/bulk/group implementation for that scope.
Validate count and parallel arrays, preserve complete signed rows, normalize units offline and compare postflight state.
checks: Use ItemTypeElm and Name together; group, object, element and selection have different meanings.
Do not combine independent extrema into a synthetic action row.
Do not change output selections on an attached session; caller state is a prerequisite.
Count API calls and requested rows before optimizing; reuse accepted context/definitions, not stale result epochs.

verification.qualification: Installed requested-object acquisition is recorded for its exact fixture/selection. Group/bulk comparisons and capacity evidence do not qualify every case type or model.

tables.purpose: Discover and read available database tables with their actual field schemas.
tables.status: Existing retained bulk table path; arbitrary table keys and schemas still require qualification.
prerequisites: Valid target, already-observed display selections, explicit requested table and row/size bounds.
steps: Read available table keys and emptiness/status metadata.
Read fields and units for the exact selected key and table version.
Use the display-array getter for in-memory reads, retaining field order and row count.
Decode only the observed qualified schema and retain per-table failure status.
checks: Display-table selection differs from Results.Setup selection.
GetTableForDisplayCSVFile writes an external file despite its Get prefix.
Do not infer a SQLite export method; inspect the installed API surface and retained export contract.

The source profile reads the complete material overwrite editing array without applying edits, and filters only explicit Frame rows from the version-1 element display table. Model count bounds precede calls; payload limits follow retrieval because the vendor API has no row-limit input.

verification.qualification: Retained schemas plus version-1 material overwrite and object/element identity tables. Raw display-selection equality and arbitrary table keys remain unqualified.

create_model.purpose: Plan an owned model creation procedure from exact installed method contracts.
create_model.status: Documented method sequence only; no new runnable creation workflow or live qualification is delivered by this guide.
prerequisites: Separate owned process/model, explicit creation scope and engineering inputs; never apply this sequence to the attached user session.
steps: Create the owned application with the installed helper contract and start it.
Initialize the model with explicit units and create a blank model.
Define materials/sections/load patterns, then geometry and assignments in dependency order.
Read back definitions and save to a new owned path; analysis is a separate stage.
checks: This is a discovery recipe, not permission or a production runner.
Consult installed help for every required/default parameter, unit, constraint and return contract.

verification.qualification: Static discovery/reference checks only. No production runner or installed acceptance for this future procedure is claimed; use the owned workflow milestone in the maintained design plan.

owned_reanalysis.purpose: Plan section changes and analysis on a separately owned copy.
owned_reanalysis.status: Future owned-copy milestone; methods are inventoried but this guide does not implement or qualify the lifecycle.
prerequisites: Saved checkpoint, non-existing owned copy destination, owned process and explicit reviewed change set; existing owned-copy authority/evidence gates apply.
steps: Create and open the owned copy in the owned application.
Capture the baseline, unlock only the owned model as required, apply exact section changes and read them back.
Choose the authorized case dependency closure and run analysis.
Read statuses and fresh force results, bind the new epoch, then save/report only within the accepted stage.
checks: Never promote an attached user session into an owned one.
No cFile.Close or proven solver cancellation/progress method is supplied by this installed inventory.
Worker timeout does not prove ETABS stopped solving; do not automatically replay.

verification.qualification: Static discovery/reference checks only. No production runner or installed acceptance for this future procedure is claimed; use the owned workflow milestone in the maintained design plan.

concrete_design.purpose: Plan concrete-design configuration, execution and diagnostic result comparison on an owned model.
concrete_design.status: Method discovery and future owned lifecycle; does not imply engineering or installed design qualification.
prerequisites: Owned analyzed model and explicit design code/preferences/overwrites, combinations, section/rebar identity and current result epoch.
steps: Read or explicitly configure design code and strength combinations within the owned stage.
Run concrete design only after prerequisites pass.
Read availability, design section and beam summary with exact item type and row semantics.
Compare like-for-like cases/stations/units and preserve warnings and design provenance.
checks: GetComboStrength is a missing maintained candidate: do not call it or infer it from SetComboStrength; the future implementation must resolve its evidence need explicitly.
An available summary or comparison is not engineering approval.

verification.qualification: Static discovery/reference checks only. No production runner or installed acceptance for this future procedure is claimed; use the owned workflow milestone in the maintained design plan.

units.purpose: Read and preserve native units, then normalize only through the admitted offline source policy.
units.status: Source definitions normalize native enum 6 and 9 through a separate profile; installed source evidence is enum 9, equivalent enum 6 is verified offline. Existing force admission is unchanged.
prerequisites: Exact runtime/target and declared getter profile; each output quantity has a known unit and sign contract.
steps: Read present and database unit enums through the existing getter host before acquisition.
Retain raw values, enum identities, field/table units and pre/postflight state with the source evidence.

For source definitions use EtabsSourceQualification: lengths to mm, source stress to N/mm2; retain raw provider coordinates/partial fixity when semantics are undocumented. Existing force snapshots continue through AnalysisSnapshotNormalizer under their original profile.
If the detailed route rejects the native units, preserve that outcome and continue only the available overview/review scope; do not set units on an attached model.
checks: Unit enum values are direct returns, not CSI status codes.
A conversion formula existing in the kernel does not qualify an untested acquisition/normalization route.
Do not apply a second conversion to already normalized quantities.

verification.qualification: C0a source definitions: installed N-mm-C and offline kN-m-C equivalence. This does not qualify the M02 native-unit force route or change older capture profiles.

loads.purpose: Resolve selected case/combination dependencies and distinguish existing static support from future dynamic source qualification.
loads.status: Existing capture admits declared static source policies; dynamic/nonlinear dependency closure is not generally qualified.
prerequisites: Exact selected case/combination names, current result epoch and an explicit admitted source profile.
steps: Read case names/types and combination terms through the maintained capture path.

Resolve each requested root independently through EtabsSourceQualification, preserving every factor, nested case/combo/pattern dependency, initial case, status and observed output selection. Unrelated unsupported roots do not block complete static peers.
For admitted linear static cases retain GetLoads definitions and source records; do not reinterpret spectrum/history/nonlinear cases as static.
Treat response-spectrum GetLoads as a discovery candidate for later qualification; inspect matching help and extend the exact adapter/decoder only within the named C0a packet.
Compare requested and observed result selections; reject incomplete dependencies instead of dropping terms or fabricating source actions.
checks: A selected result name is not a complete source-dependency description.
GetLoads on different case interfaces has different semantics and parameters.
Preserve unsupported case types and missing dependencies; repeated discovery must not silently widen the source profile.

verification.qualification: Installed 32-root definition scope: 17 complete_static_source and 15 unsupported. No applied load capture, ULS/SLS role assignment, dynamic result qualification or force synthesis.

supports.purpose: Discover member releases, point restraints, offsets and connectivity without assuming they prove a physical support model.
supports.status: Existing member capture records releases/restraints/offsets; general support and physical-span interpretation remains C0a.
prerequisites: Current object/element/point identities, local/global-axis conventions and an explicit support interpretation profile.
steps: Reuse member capture for endpoints, GetReleases, GetRestraint, GetInsertionPoint_1 and end offsets.
Keep frame releases and point restraints separate; retain axes and partial-fixity data from their actual contracts.
Use the source profile's exact GetConnectivity getter to retain object types/names and point numbers with native-unit endpoint facts. Keep physical support interpretation separate.
Build physical spans/supports only after the named interpretation profile and independent examples are accepted; source facts and assumed review supports remain distinct.
checks: Use the registered GetInsertionPoint_1 signature rather than substituting a similarly named overload.
A restrained point, connected object or release flag alone does not prove beam effective span or boundary condition.
A mesh node is not automatically a physical support.

verification.qualification: Installed endpoint connectivity and release/offset facts for 20 frames and 40 points; no physical support/continuity/span qualification.

result_selection.purpose: Observe the distinct result and display-table selections before requesting existing analysis results.
result_selection.status: Registered selection getters and inspection/capture checks exist; attached selection setters are outside this read-only lifecycle.
prerequisites: Exact target and existing finished results; explicit requested cases/combinations and getter profile.
steps: Observe Results.Setup case/combination selection and separately observe DatabaseTables display selection.
Compare observed state with the selected operation requirements before acquisition.
Request the scoped existing getter path and preserve actual case/combination/step identities.
Recheck protected state and retain mismatch/no-result outcomes without silently selecting all cases or changing the attached model.
checks: Display-table selection and Results.Setup selection are separate domains.
Empty results are not evidence that an unselected case has zero action.
Output selection does not choose solver run flags.

verification.qualification: Retained inspection/scoped-capture evidence; arbitrary selection changes and new table schemas remain separate qualification work.

recovery.purpose: Handle cancelled, timed-out or failed acquisition through the existing broker and retained evidence.
recovery.status: Existing bounded broker/lease/journal behavior; this is a host procedure with no invented ETABS cancel method.
prerequisites: Operation identity, exact target/worker ownership, deadline and task-owned durable evidence directory.
steps: Inspect the recorded operation state, raw STARTED/RETURNED evidence and cleanup result.
Use the owning broker cancellation/cleanup path; retain incomplete or uncertain outcomes.
Do not kill the attached ETABS process, steal its lease or infer solver cancellation from worker exit.
Diagnose the failing stage and source identity before retry; a partial capture cannot become an accepted complete snapshot.
Record the symptom, confirmed or unconfirmed cause, evidence and next action in the task plan/session entry; replan when the accepted contract changes.
checks: No solver cancellation/progress method is qualified by the catalogue.
Distinguish task cancellation, deadline expiry, decode failure and cleanup failure.
Do not weaken timeouts, durability or completeness checks to turn a failed run green.

verification.qualification: Existing broker and retained scoped cleanup evidence. Hosted deadline variability RR-046 is an unresolved observation, not a proved production defect or a new cancellation capability.

source.purpose: Capture bounded native-unit source facts and static load dependency closures without changing the selected ETABS model.
source.status: Implemented separate source worker/profile; exact M02 installed development evidence plus independent raw-call replay. Candidate-bound final verdict is external.
prerequisites: Exact PID/start/executable, expected saved-model SHA-256, future deadline, fresh request/response/evidence paths, 1..20 frame names and 1..32 case/combination roots.
Observe source frame count <=20000. Each full table must remain <=200000 rows/1000000 cells; vendor allocation occurs before returned-size validation.
steps: Use overview/inspection to freeze model identity and explicit scope before seeing new results.
Dispatch StructAutomate.EtabsWorker --source-request request.json --response response.json using structural.etabs_source_request/v1; see the guide for the exact contract.
Reuse EtabsSourceBroker and the shared lease/STA/journal/deadline/quiescence boundary; its reader caches repeated properties and proves successful facts equal before/after.

Read versioned material overwrite and element identity tables once; filter Frame rows and reconcile reverse object/element endpoints. Retain source coordinates, properties, releases, offsets and configured station settings.
Normalize only documented dimensions; resolve each selected static definition closure independently and retain all unsupported/unavailable peers.
Require completed plus quiescent response, unchanged source file and protected facts, and raw-call replay before accepting evidence. Update the receipt/plan before candidate freeze.
checks: Source definitions only; applied loads and force rows are not read.
Connectivity, releases, offsets and axes do not establish physical supports, effective span or member design role.
Output station configuration is distinct from actual force-result stations; raw RDI/RDJ coordinate semantics remain unqualified.
Static root closure does not assign ULS/SLS roles, prove concurrent dynamic actions, establish current in-memory result freshness, or admit engineering design.
Known table display-case getter mismatch remains outside this profile; no complete table-selection equality claim.
Independent source/holdout count, cross-model support and PF9 certification are unchanged.

verification.qualification: Exact source definitions only; live no-overwrite material branch and N-mm-C. Explicit overwrites/kN-m-C fixture evidence remain separate; broader C0a and design support are not complete.
